Role: Backend Software Engineer
Company: CloudScale Systems
Source: https://jobs.lever.co/cloudscale/backend-engineer-2026

About the Role:
CloudScale is looking for a Backend Software Engineer to help build our core distributed platform.
You will write clean, well-tested code, build scalable APIs, and design efficient relational database models.

Key Requirements & Responsibilities:
- Experience building RESTful APIs with FastAPI or Express
- Strong proficiency in Python for backend service development
- Relational database experience with SQL queries, schema design, and Postgres
- Dedicated experience with automated testing using pytest or unit tests
- Familiarity with containerization and Docker deployment workflows
- Understanding of Git version control and collaborative branching
- Strong foundation in Data Structures and Algorithms
- Experience building microservices with Go is a plus
- Knowledge of CI/CD continuous integration pipelines
- Understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles
